description: Live testing only: creates a part from the default part template holding one block, x by y by z mm, from the origin along +X, +Y and +Z (a rectangle on the first plane extruded along its normal), and saves it as a new file in the live suite's scratch directory. Refused unless diagnostics are on.

path.description: The new part's full path: a .SLDPRT file under %LOCALAPPDATA%/solidworks-mcp/live-scratch that does not exist yet.

x_mm.description: Size along X, mm, more than 0 and at most 1000.

y_mm.description: Size along Y, mm, more than 0 and at most 1000.

z_mm.description: Size along Z, mm, more than 0 and at most 1000.
